enonce_markdown: Two parents who live together with their own children, and with nobody else, form what type of family?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Families are classified according to the people who belong to them.

### Solution

A nuclear family is composed of two parents and their children. An extended family also includes other relatives, a single-parent family has only one parent, and a reconstituted family joins children of earlier unions.

**Answer: b.**

enonce_markdown: A group of people who live in the same area and share common interests and a common way of life is called a ...
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

A community is defined by living in the same place and sharing interests, values and problems.

### Solution

A club or school is an organised group with a specific purpose, and a family is a group of relatives. People living in the same village or neighbourhood who share interests and concerns form a community.

**Answer: d.**

enonce_markdown: Tanyi lives in the same compound with his parents, his grandmother, an uncle and two cousins. This household is an example of a/an ...
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

An extended family is the nuclear family plus other close relatives who live together or are closely linked.

### Solution

The presence of grandmother, uncle and cousins besides the parents and children shows an extended family. A nuclear family would have only parents and children.

**Answer: a.**

enonce_markdown: Which of the following is a responsibility of **parents** towards their children?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Responsibilities of parents are what they must give to their children; the other items are duties of children.

### Solution

Parents must feed, shelter, educate and protect their children. Obeying rules, helping with chores and respecting elders are duties of children.

**Answer: c.**

enonce_markdown: Explain **two** ways in which members of a community can contribute to the development of their village or neighbourhood.
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Give each contribution, say how it helps, and illustrate it with an example.

### Solution

1. **Community self-help projects:** members give their labour or money to build or repair things used by all. *Example:* repairing a village footpath or a bridge.
2. **Keeping the surroundings clean:** members take part in cleaning days, which protects health. *Example:* cleaning the water source and clearing bushes around houses.

(Other valid answers: taking part in community meetings, supporting the school, settling disputes peacefully.)

enonce_markdown: Which of the following statements about types of family is **correct**?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Compare each statement with the exact definition of the family type it names.

### Solution

Option a describes an extended family, not a nuclear one. Option c is wrong because a family may have one parent because of death, divorce, separation or birth outside marriage. Option d describes polyandry; in a polygynous family one man has several wives. Only option b is correct.

**Answer: b.**

choix.texte: A nuclear family is made up of parents, children and grandparents
An extended family includes the nuclear family and other relatives
A single-parent family exists only when one parent has died
A polygynous family is one in which a woman has several husbands
